literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, an edict ordered a personal campaign; the monk Jianianu was sent bearing a letter to sue for peace, naming Aguda by name in reproach.
idiomatic: In the fifth year, spring, first month, the court issued an edict ordering a personal campaign and sent the monk Jianianu with a letter to sue for peace, naming Aguda by name in reproach.

literal: Aguda sent Saisi with a reply; [1] if the rebel Ashu is returned and Huanglong Prefecture is moved elsewhere, then matters may be discussed.
idiomatic: Aguda sent Saisi with a reply: [1] if the rebel Ashu is returned and Huanglong Prefecture is moved to another site, then matters may be discussed.

literal: Commander-in-chief Yelü Woliduo and others fought Jurchen troops at Daru Ancient City and were defeated.
idiomatic: Commander-in-chief Yelü Woliduo and others fought Jurchen troops at Daru Ancient City and were defeated.

literal: Second month, Goyu of Rao Prefecture Bohai and others rebelled and styled themselves great king.
idiomatic: In the second month Goyu of Rao Prefecture Bohai and others rebelled and styled themselves great king.

literal: Third month, Xiao Xiefoliu and others were sent to attack them.
idiomatic: In the third month Xiao Xiefoliu and others were sent to attack them.

literal: Yelü Zhangnu and six others were dispatched bearing letters as envoys to the Jurchen, naming their lord in reproach, hoping he would surrender quickly.
idiomatic: Yelü Zhangnu and six others were dispatched bearing letters as envoys to the Jurchen, naming their lord in reproach in hope of a quick surrender.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on guichou day Xiao Xiefoliu and others were defeated by Bohai Goyu; Southern Court associate deployment director Xiao Tao Suwo was made commander-in-chief and sent against them.
idiomatic: On guichou day of the fourth summer month Xiao Xiefoliu and others were defeated by Bohai Goyu; Southern Court associate deployment director Xiao Tao Suwo was made commander-in-chief and sent against them.

literal: Fifth month, Tao Suwo fought Goyu and was defeated.
idiomatic: In the fifth month Tao Suwo fought Goyu and was defeated.

literal: Zhangnu and others brought Aguda's letter; they were sent back again.
idiomatic: Zhangnu and others brought Aguda's letter; they were sent back again.

literal: Sixth month, on jihai new moon, summer retreat at Teli Ridge.
idiomatic: On the jihai new moon of the sixth month the court took summer retreat at Teli Ridge.

literal: On renzi day Zhangnu and others returned; Aguda replied again, also naming him in reproach and urging surrender.
idiomatic: On renzi day Zhangnu and others returned; Aguda replied again, also naming him in reproach and urging surrender.

literal: On guichou day the personal campaign was announced to all circuits.
idiomatic: On guichou day the personal campaign was announced to all circuits.

literal: On bingchen day Tao Suwo induced Goyu and others to submit.
idiomatic: On bingchen day Tao Suwo induced Goyu and others to submit.

literal: On guihai day tiyin Yelü Moli was made Northern Court great king.
idiomatic: On guihai day tiyin Yelü Moli was made Northern Court great king.

literal: That month Xiao Cici was sent as envoy to the Jurchen; because his letter was not submissive he was detained.
idiomatic: That month Xiao Cici was sent as envoy to the Jurchen; because his letter was not submissive he was detained.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinwei day Song dispatched envoys presenting silver and silk to assist the army.
idiomatic: On xinwei day of the seventh autumn month Song dispatched envoys presenting silver and silk to assist the army.

literal: On bingzi day hunted east of the ridge.
idiomatic: On bingzi day the court hunted east of the ridge.

literal: That month commander-in-chief Woliduo and others fought the Jurchen at White Horse Marsh and were defeated.
idiomatic: That month commander-in-chief Woliduo and others fought the Jurchen at White Horse Marsh and were defeated.

literal: Eighth month, on jiazi day the hunt was ended and the court hastened to the army.
idiomatic: On jiazi day of the eighth month the court ended the hunt and hastened to the army.

literal: Because Woliduo and others' army was defeated, they were dismissed from office.
idiomatic: Because Woliduo and others' army was defeated, they were dismissed from office.

literal: On bingyin day park commissioner A Bu was made central army commander-in-chief and Yelü Zhangnu made inspector; they led a hundred thousand Fan and Han troops;
idiomatic: On bingyin day park commissioner A Bu was made central army commander-in-chief and Yelü Zhangnu inspector; they led a hundred thousand Fan and Han troops;

literal: Xiao Fengxian served as imperial camp commander-in-chief; all mobile camp deployment director Yelü Zhangnu was deputy; [2] twenty thousand elite troops were the vanguard.
idiomatic: Xiao Fengxian served as imperial camp commander-in-chief; all mobile camp deployment director Yelü Zhangnu was deputy; [2] twenty thousand elite troops formed the vanguard.

literal: The remainder were divided into five divisions as the main army; a thousand noble sons formed the hard army; the hundred offices of the entourage formed the guard army; they marched north out of Camel Pass;
idiomatic: The remainder were divided into five divisions as the main army; a thousand noble sons formed the hard army; the hundred offices of the entourage formed the guard army; they marched north out of Camel Pass;

literal: Chief inspector Xiao Hudu Gu was made commander-in-chief and privy council academician Chai Yi deputy; they led thirty thousand Han infantry and cavalry south out of Ningjiang Prefecture.
idiomatic: Chief inspector Xiao Hudu Gu was made commander-in-chief with privy council academician Chai Yi as deputy; they led thirty thousand Han infantry and cavalry south out of Ningjiang Prefecture.

literal: From Changchun Prefecture they advanced by separate routes, issuing several months' grain, with a fixed date to destroy the Jurchen.
idiomatic: From Changchun Prefecture they advanced by separate routes, issuing several months' grain, with a fixed date to destroy the Jurchen.

literal: Ninth month, on dingmao new moon, Jurchen troops captured Huanglong Prefecture.
idiomatic: On the dingmao new moon of the ninth month Jurchen troops captured Huanglong Prefecture.

literal: On jisi day Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Delidi went out as Southwest Route pacification commissioner.
idiomatic: On jisi day Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Delidi went out as Southwest Route pacification commissioner.

literal: Cici returned; the Jurchen again sent Saisi with a letter reporting: if our rebels Ashu and others are returned, we shall withdraw the army.
idiomatic: Cici returned; the Jurchen again sent Saisi with a letter reporting that if our rebels Ashu and others were returned they would withdraw the army.

literal: The emperor personally campaigned.
idiomatic: The emperor personally campaigned.

literal: Nianhan, Wushu, and others sent a letter up; outwardly humble and mournful words, in truth seeking battle.
idiomatic: Nianhan, Wushu, and others sent a letter up; outwardly humble and mournful words, in truth seeking battle.

literal: When the letter arrived the emperor was angry and issued an edict with the words "The Jurchen have committed offenses; the great army shall cut them down."
idiomatic: When the letter arrived the emperor was angry and issued an edict with the words "The Jurchen have committed offenses; the great army shall cut them down."

literal: The Jurchen lord gathered the masses, faced heaven and wept aloud, saying: "When I first raised troops with you it was because we suffered under Khitan cruelty and wished to establish our own state.
idiomatic: The Jurchen lord gathered the masses, faced heaven, and wept aloud, saying, "When I first raised troops with you it was because we suffered under Khitan cruelty and wished to establish our own state.

literal: Now the sovereign personally campaigns — what is to be done?
idiomatic: Now the sovereign personally campaigns — what is to be done?

literal: Unless men fight to the death none can withstand him.
idiomatic: Unless men fight to the death none can withstand him.

literal: Better to kill my whole clan; you welcome surrender and turn misfortune into fortune.
idiomatic: Better to kill my whole clan; you welcome surrender and turn misfortune into fortune.

literal: " All the armies said: "Things have come to this; we obey your command.
idiomatic: All the armies said, "Things have come to this; we obey your command.

literal: " On yisi day Yelü Zhangnu rebelled, fled to the Supreme Capital, and plotted to welcome Prince of Wei Chun to the throne.
idiomatic: On yisi day Yelü Zhangnu rebelled, fled to the Supreme Capital, and plotted to welcome Prince of Wei Chun to the throne.

literal: The emperor sent imperial son-in-law Xiao Yu leading troops to Guangping Marsh to guard the empress and consorts; mobile palace attendant Yixin bore a letter at full gallop to report to Prince of Wei.
idiomatic: The emperor sent imperial son-in-law Xiao Yu leading troops to Guangping Marsh to guard the empress and consorts; mobile palace attendant Yixin bore a letter at full gallop to report to Prince of Wei.

literal: At that time Zhangnu had first sent the consort's younger brother Xiao Dili to explain the plot to Prince of Wei.
idiomatic: At that time Zhangnu had first sent the consort's younger brother Xiao Dili to explain the plot to Prince of Wei.

literal: The prince said: "This is no small matter; the sovereign has his own princes who should be enthroned; Northern and Southern Court great ministers have not come — yet you speak of this — how so?
idiomatic: The prince said, "This is no small matter; the sovereign has his own princes who should be enthroned; Northern and Southern Court great ministers have not come — yet you speak of this — how so?

literal: " He secretly ordered attendants to seize him.
idiomatic: He secretly ordered attendants to seize him.

literal: Shortly after, Yixin and others' imperial missive arrived, fully stating Zhangnu and others' plot to depose and enthrone.
idiomatic: Shortly after, Yixin and others' imperial missive arrived, fully stating Zhangnu and others' plot to depose and enthrone.

literal: Prince of Wei at once beheaded Xiao Dili and others' heads to present; alone on horseback by a hidden path he went to Guangping Marsh to await punishment.
idiomatic: Prince of Wei at once beheaded Xiao Dili and others' heads to present; alone on horseback by a hidden path he went to Guangping Marsh to await punishment.

literal: The emperor received him as at first.
idiomatic: The emperor received him as at first.

literal: Zhangnu, learning Prince of Wei would not listen, led his followers to plunder Qing, Rao, Huai, Zu, and other prefectures, joined Bohai bandits, and when his force reached tens of thousands hastened to Guangping Marsh to attack the mobile palace.
idiomatic: Zhangnu, learning Prince of Wei would not listen, led his followers to plunder Qing, Rao, Huai, Zu, and other prefectures, joined Bohai bandits, and when his force reached tens of thousands hastened to Guangping Marsh to attack the mobile palace.

literal: Shunguo Jurchen Ahechan with three hundred horsemen won in a single battle, captured more than two hundred of their nobles, and beheaded them all to display.
idiomatic: Shunguo Jurchen Ahechan with three hundred horsemen won in a single battle, captured more than two hundred of their nobles, and beheaded them all to display.

literal: Their wives and children were assigned to the embroidery office or dispersed among close attendants as maidservants; the rest who escaped all fled to the Jurchen.
idiomatic: Their wives and children were assigned to the embroidery office or dispersed among close attendants as maidservants; the rest who escaped all fled to the Jurchen.

literal: Zhangnu pretended to be an envoy and wished to flee to the Jurchen; border guards seized him, bound him, and sent him to the imperial camp; he was cut at the waist in the market, his heart cut out and offered at the ancestral temple, and his limbs displayed on the Five Routes.
idiomatic: Zhangnu pretended to be an envoy and wished to flee to the Jurchen; border guards seized him, bound him, and sent him to the imperial camp; he was cut at the waist in the market, his heart cut out and offered at the ancestral temple, and his limbs displayed on the Five Routes.

literal: Winter, eleventh month, imperial son-in-law Xiao Temu, linya Xiao Chala, and others led fifty thousand cavalry, four hundred thousand infantry, and seven hundred thousand imperial guards to Tuomen.
idiomatic: In the eleventh winter month imperial son-in-law Xiao Temu, linya Xiao Chala, and others led fifty thousand cavalry, four hundred thousand infantry, and seven hundred thousand imperial guards to Tuomen.

literal: Twelfth month, on yisi day Yelü Zhangnu rebelled.
idiomatic: On yisi day of the twelfth month Yelü Zhangnu rebelled.

literal: [3] On wushen day fought in person at Hubudada and was defeated; all baggage was lost.
idiomatic: [3] On wushen day the emperor fought in person at Hubudada and was defeated; all baggage was lost.

literal: On jiwei day Jin Prefecture prefect Yelü Shuze rebelled and joined Zhangnu.
idiomatic: On jiwei day Jin Prefecture prefect Yelü Shuze rebelled and joined Zhangnu.

literal: [4] On gengshen day Northern Court linya Yelü Mage attacked Zhangnu.
idiomatic: [4] On gengshen day Northern Court linya Yelü Mage attacked Zhangnu.

literal: On guihai day Northern Court palace commissioner Xiao Hanjianu administered Northern Court privy commissioner affairs; Southern Court palace commissioner Xiao Temu was made Han mobile palace deployment director.
idiomatic: On guihai day Northern Court palace commissioner Xiao Hanjianu administered Northern Court privy commissioner affairs; Southern Court palace commissioner Xiao Temu was made Han mobile palace deployment director.

literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, on bingyin new moon, at the Eastern Capital evil youths of more than ten at night, drunk, took blades, scaled the wall into the regent's residence, and asked where regent Xiao Baoxian was: "There is a military mutiny; please prepare.
idiomatic: In the sixth year, on the bingyin new moon of the first spring month, at the Eastern Capital more than ten evil youths at night, drunk, took blades, scaled the wall into the regent's residence, and asked where regent Xiao Baoxian was: "There is a military mutiny; please prepare.

literal: " Xiao Baoxian came out; they stabbed and killed him.
idiomatic: Xiao Baoxian came out; they stabbed and killed him.

literal: Household Ministry commissioner Da Gongding heard of the disorder, immediately assumed regent affairs, and with associate regent Gao Qingming gathered a thousand Xi and Han troops; [5] they captured the whole band, beheaded them, and pacified the people.
idiomatic: Household Ministry commissioner Da Gongding heard of the disorder, immediately assumed regent affairs, and with associate regent Gao Qingming gathered a thousand Xi and Han troops; [5] they captured the whole band, beheaded them, and pacified the people.

literal: The Eastern Capital was formerly Bohai territory; the Founder fought more than twenty years before obtaining it.
idiomatic: The Eastern Capital was formerly Bohai territory; the Founder fought more than twenty years before obtaining it.

literal: Xiao Baoxian was harsh; the Bohai suffered under him, hence this mutiny.
idiomatic: Xiao Baoxian was harsh; the Bohai suffered under him, hence this mutiny.

literal: His lieutenant Bohai Gao Yongchang usurped title and styled the era Longji first year.
idiomatic: His lieutenant Bohai Gao Yongchang usurped title and styled the era Longji first year.

literal: [6] Xiao Yixue and Gao Xingshun were sent to induce submission; they did not obey.
idiomatic: [6] Xiao Yixue and Gao Xingshun were sent to induce submission; they did not obey.

literal: Intercalary month, on jihai day Xiao Hanjianu and Zhang Lin were sent to attack them.
idiomatic: On jihai day of the intercalary month Xiao Hanjianu and Zhang Lin were sent to attack them.

literal: On wuwu day Guida Prefecture defending general Yelü Yudu, because Guang Prefecture Bohai rebelled and joined Yongchang, our army defeated him.
idiomatic: On wuwu day Guida Prefecture defending general Yelü Yudu, because Guang Prefecture Bohai rebelled and joined Yongchang, our army defeated him.

literal: Second month, on wuchen day attendant imperial son-in-law Tabuye and others attacked Zhangnu; they fought at Zu Prefecture and were defeated.
idiomatic: On wuchen day of the second month attendant imperial son-in-law Tabuye and others attacked Zhangnu; they fought at Zu Prefecture and were defeated.

literal: On yiyou day Han mobile palace deployment director Xiao Temu was sent leading the generals to attack Zhangnu.
idiomatic: On yiyou day Han mobile palace deployment director Xiao Temu was sent leading the generals to attack Zhangnu.

literal: On wuzi day Zhangnu induced Rao Prefecture Bohai and Central Capital bandit Hou Kai and more than ten thousand others; they attacked and captured Gao Prefecture.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Zhangnu induced Rao Prefecture Bohai and Central Capital bandit Hou Kai and more than ten thousand others; they attacked and captured Gao Prefecture.

literal: Third month, Eastern Route deputy field commander Chouwo captured Hou Kai at Chuan Prefecture.
idiomatic: In the third month Eastern Route deputy field commander Chouwo captured Hou Kai at Chuan Prefecture.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on wuchen day personally campaigned against Zhangnu.
idiomatic: On wuchen day of the fourth summer month the emperor personally campaigned against Zhangnu.

literal: On guiyou day he defeated him.
idiomatic: On guiyou day he defeated him.

literal: On jiaxu day the rebel party was executed; Rao Prefecture Bohai was pacified.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day the rebel party was executed; Rao Prefecture Bohai was pacified.

literal: On bingzi day rewards were given differentially to officers and soldiers who pacified the bandits;
idiomatic: On bingzi day rewards were given differentially to officers and soldiers who pacified the bandits;

literal: yet Xiao Hanjianu, Zhang Lin, and others were again defeated by the bandits.
idiomatic: yet Xiao Hanjianu, Zhang Lin, and others were again defeated by the bandits.

literal: Fifth month, summer retreat at Sanshui Plain.
idiomatic: In the fifth month the court took summer retreat at Sanshui Plain.

literal: Jurchen troops captured Shen Prefecture, again took the Eastern Capital, and captured Gao Yongchang.
idiomatic: Jurchen troops captured Shen Prefecture, again took the Eastern Capital, and captured Gao Yongchang.

literal: Eastern Capital prefecture and county clansmen Henbo, Duola, Wu Shi, Tabuye, Daola, Chouwo, and thirteen others all surrendered to the Jurchen.
idiomatic: Eastern Capital prefecture and county clansmen Henbo, Duola, Wu Shi, Tabuye, Daola, Chouwo, and thirteen others all surrendered to the Jurchen.

literal: Sixth month, on chou day troops of all circuits were registered; those with ten or more mixed livestock were all conscripted.
idiomatic: On chou day of the sixth month troops of all circuits were registered; those with ten or more mixed livestock were all conscripted.

literal: On gengchen day Prince of Wei Chun was advanced to King of Qin-Jin and made supreme commander;
idiomatic: On gengchen day Prince of Wei Chun was advanced to King of Qin-Jin and made supreme commander;

literal: Supreme Capital regent Xiao Tabuye was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director and also deputy supreme commander.
idiomatic: Supreme Capital regent Xiao Tabuye was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director and also deputy supreme commander.

literal: On dinghai day privy commissioner Xiao Hanjianu was made Supreme Capital regent.
idiomatic: On dinghai day privy commissioner Xiao Hanjianu was made Supreme Capital regent.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, hunted at Autumn Mountain.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Autumn Mountain.

literal: More than two thousand households of Chun Prefecture Bohai rebelled; Northeast Route field army commander led troops in pursuit, overtook them, and captured them all and returned.
idiomatic: More than two thousand households of Chun Prefecture Bohai rebelled; the Northeast Route field army commander led troops in pursuit, overtook them, and captured them all and returned.

literal: Eighth month, Wugu tribe rebelled; censor Yelü Tabuye and others were sent to induce them.
idiomatic: In the eighth month the Wugu tribe rebelled; censor Yelü Tabuye and others were sent to induce them.

literal: Ninth month, on bingwu day visited Huai Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On bingwu day of the ninth month the court visited Huai Mausoleum.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingmao day because Zhang Lin's army was defeated he was dismissed from office.
idiomatic: On dingmao day of the tenth winter month because Zhang Lin's army was defeated he was dismissed from office.

literal: On gengchen day the Wugu tribe came to surrender.
idiomatic: On gengchen day the Wugu tribe came to surrender.

literal: Eleventh month, Eastern Route deputy field commander Mage and others attacked Yisu Hall and were defeated.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month Eastern Route deputy field commander Mage and others attacked Yisu Hall and were defeated.

literal: Twelfth month, on yihai day commoner Lady Xiao was enfeoffed as Grand Imperial Consort.
idiomatic: On yihai day of the twelfth month commoner Lady Xiao was enfeoffed as Grand Imperial Consort.

literal: On xinsi day deputy commander Yelü Mage was stripped of office.
idiomatic: On xinsi day deputy commander Yelü Mage was stripped of office.

literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, on jiayin day stable horse grain was reduced and distributed to the various bureaus.
idiomatic: In the seventh year, on jiayin day of the first spring month, stable horse grain was reduced and distributed to the various bureaus.

literal: That month Jurchen troops attacked Chun Prefecture; Northeastern armies fled without fighting; Nügu, Pishi four divisions, and Bohai people all surrendered; they again took Taizhou [7].
idiomatic: That month Jurchen troops attacked Chun Prefecture; Northeastern armies fled without fighting; Nügu, Pishi four divisions, and Bohai people all surrendered; they again took Taizhou [7].

literal: Second month, Lianshui County bandit Dong Peng'er gathered more than ten thousand; Western Capital regent Xiao Yixue and Nanjing field army inspector Zhala fought them on the Yi River and broke them.
idiomatic: In the second month Lianshui County bandit Dong Peng'er gathered more than ten thousand; Western Capital regent Xiao Yixue and Nanjing field army inspector Zhala fought them on the Yi River and broke them.

literal: Third month, Peng'er's party gathered again; Yixue again defeated them at Fengsheng Prefecture.
idiomatic: In the third month Peng'er's party gathered again; Yixue again defeated them at Fengsheng Prefecture.

literal: Summer, fifth month, on gengyin day Eastern Route field army generals Neli, Helu, Nige, and Xugu were executed in the market.
idiomatic: On gengyin day of the fifth summer month Eastern Route field army generals Neli, Helu, Nige, and Xugu were executed in the market.

literal: On yisi day in the gaps of all hunting parks the common people were allowed to gather firewood.
idiomatic: On yisi day in the gaps of all hunting parks the common people were allowed to gather firewood.

literal: Sixth month, on xinsi day associate privy commissioner Yuliye was made Northern Court great king.
idiomatic: On xinsi day of the sixth month associate privy commissioner Yuliye was made Northern Court great king.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on guimao day hunted at Autumn Mountain.
idiomatic: On guimao day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Autumn Mountain.

literal: Eighth month, on bingyin day hunted at Sinari Mountain; ordered supreme commander King of Qin-Jin to go to the border and assemble four-route troops to guard against autumn raids.
idiomatic: On bingyin day of the eighth month the court hunted at Sinari Mountain and ordered supreme commander King of Qin-Jin to go to the border and assemble four-route troops to guard against autumn raids.

literal: Ninth month, the emperor from Yan arrived at Yinliang River and established eight Resentment Army camps: those recruited from Yi Prefecture were called Front Yi and Rear Yi; from Jin Prefecture Front Jin and Rear Jin; from Qian and Xian Front Qian and Front Xian; also the great Qian-Xian camp and Yanz Prefecture camp — in all more than twenty-eight thousand men — stationed at Jili Mountain, Weizhou.
idiomatic: In the ninth month the emperor from Yan arrived at Yinliang River and established eight Resentment Army camps: those recruited from Yi Prefecture were called Front Yi and Rear Yi; from Jin Prefecture Front Jin and Rear Jin; from Qian and Xian Front Qian and Front Xian; also the great Qian-Xian camp and Yanz Prefecture camp — in all more than twenty-eight thousand men — stationed at Jili Mountain, Weizhou.

literal: On dingyou day hunted at Wangzi Mountain.
idiomatic: On dingyou day the court hunted at Wangzi Mountain.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on yimao new moon, arrived at Central Capital.
idiomatic: On the yimao new moon of the tenth winter month the court arrived at Central Capital.
